system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named AssemblyArmRejectF for the fixed-base articulated manipulator domain. Mission: Hold a nonzero joint target while rejecting a finite-duration lateral load at the distal link. Embodiment: A fixed base supports four serial revolute joints with Z, Y, Y, and X axes, capsule-link lengths 0.50 m, 0.40 m, 0.28 m, and 0.16 m, and masses 7 kg, 5 kg, 3 kg, and 1 kg. Actuation: Saturated effort drives use position and velocity feedback on all four axes, and do not exceed 134 N.m. Observation: Encoders and the wrist wrench sensor record the response before, during, and after the load. Operating context: Model gravity and self-collision between nonadjacent links. Control: use saturated state-feedback control with integral disturbance rejection. Robustness case: apply a controlled 26.1 N disturbance disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require finite states, no self-collision, peak deviation below 0.18 rad, and recovery to the target band, primary tracking error below 0.028 rad-or-m after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
